title: test(dogfood): pin that an uninstalled package's commit is refused through its own revert and rollback path
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8XLHN88q15iozXharJ28kGk)_
Fixes #29234
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在 `package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts` 加一例：装一个包、发布一次提交、卸载，再经它自己的路径回退单个提交和回滚，两者都答 `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`（`Package 'ID' not found`），什么都不写。
- 为什么改：#29090 的 changeset 对外写了「已卸载包的提交，经它自己的路径回退也答 404」，此前只是读代码得出，没有测试钉住；以后改卸载或回退门的判断顺序时，这句发布出去的话可能悄悄变假。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试，不动源码、不发布；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：该 dogfood 文件新增的 `an uninstalled package's commit is refused 404 …` 一例。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/qa/dogfood && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 `Tests 8 passed (8)`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One new case in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts`, plus three header lines naming it. No source change.

The case creates its own package (`app.cmtprobe-gone`), publishes one object through it, and reads its commit trail. It then uninstalls the package with `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id` (200), and asserts:

- the object is no longer served, and `GET /packages/:id/commits` still lists exactly the trail it had before the uninstall;
- `POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert` and `POST /packages/:id/rollback` with `{ commitId }` each answer `404` with `error.code` `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` and message `Package 'app.cmtprobe-gone' not found`;
- after both refusals the trail is unchanged (no revert commit written) and the object is still not served.

It uses its own package, so the order of the other cases and their commit counts on A and B are untouched.

## Why

The #29090 changeset's third FROM → TO pair says an uninstalled package's history no longer takes new revert commits through its own path. The existing "unknown package" case uses an id that was never installed, so it never reaches a package whose commits outlive its registry entry. This pins the shipped sentence.

## Tests

Run on head `248b3fb3` (base main `96fb7b5d`), from the built dogfood closure:

<details><summary>dogfood file</summary>

```text
cd packages/qa/dogfood && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  8 passed (8)
NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 pnpm typecheck  -> exit 0
```

</details>

The new case is green on main, so the card's stop rule does not fire. The first run asserted a guessed `error.code` of `NOT_FOUND` and went red on that line only; the measured envelope is `{"code":"RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND","message":"Package 'app.cmtprobe-gone' not found","httpStatus":404}`, and the assertion now pins that. No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour.

- None.
